description: This file is a shell library used for CVS import tests. It sources another script, performs environment checks, sets up CVS repositories, checks out branches from CVS and Git, and compares directory trees and files to verify consistency between CVS and Git repositories during testing.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository by copying the CVS root directory.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out a CVS branch or main trunk for testing.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out a specific branch in a Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares a file in CVS and Git for a specific branch.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares the directory trees and files between CVS and Git for a specific branch.
